title: 第7章 播种购买新鱼苗第8章 空元朗危机逼近
content_zh:
“爷爷，如果到时候灵鱼无法带来足够的灵石收入，我们不妨考虑撤掉灵鱼湖，利用那边的灵穴来开辟更多的灵田。
不过，这一切都要等到我晋升到炼气后期，到那时我应该就有能力打理五亩以上的灵田了。”李衍道提出了自己的想法。
听到孙儿的建议，李松鹤微微一愣，随即笑容满面地回应道：“好啊，一切听孙儿的安排。”
灵田开辟后，如果缺乏灵脉所提供的灵穴支持，那么几年之后，灵田中的灵力就会逐渐枯竭，最终导致无法继续种植灵植。
虽然灵田不在灵穴之上开启依然可以赚取一些灵石，但收益会大大降低，平均下来，一亩灵田一年可能只能赚取两三块灵石。
然而，如果有灵穴的存在，则情形完全不同。
从灵穴中不断涌现的灵气，能够充分满足灵田的消耗需求。
即使是以入门级别的云雨术进行灌溉，一亩灵田每年也可以带来大约十块灵石的收入。
风林岛上共有六处灵穴，其中五处用于开辟灵湖，饲养灵鱼，而另一处则专门用于开辟灵田。
目前，李家这五亩灵田下的灵穴每天可以产生五缕灵气，可以稳定支持五亩灵田的消耗。
五个灵鱼湖中，有一个灵穴尤为突出，它每天能够产生十缕灵气。
如果这个最大的灵穴被用来开辟灵田，那么它足以培育出一亩一阶极品的灵田。
这样的灵田能够种植出品质极高的灵植。
至于其他的四个灵湖，它们的灵穴每天产生的灵气数量分别为一缕、两缕、三缕和六缕。
其中，两缕灵气可以用来培育一亩一阶中品的灵田，而五缕灵气则可以支持一亩一阶上品灵田的生长。
由此可见，灵脉中的灵穴对于灵田的重要性不言而喻。
在完成了灵田的开辟之后，李衍道不得不耐心等待整整一个月的时间，以便让这片新土地充分吸收四周弥漫的灵气。
待到约定的播种之日，李衍道与其爷爷踏上了这两亩新辟的灵田，开始了播种。
他们小心翼翼地将珍贵的水灵米种子撒入土中。
这些灵种的价格不菲，总共耗费了四块灵石才得以购得。

灵田播种并非灵植师的专长，在李家，每当有新的灵田需要播种时，家族成员们总是会一起行动。
这一天，李林燕与李衍云也前来协助。
然而，当播种完成后，李林燕与李衍云的目光不由自主地投向了邻近的灵田，那里正是由李衍道亲自照料的水灵米。
他们脸上显露出些许疑惑，因为眼前所见让他们感到惊讶不已。
李林燕终于按捺不住心中的好奇，开口询问道：
“衍道侄儿，为何你这一个月来种植的水灵米，其稻穗上结出的灵米竟比我们所种的要多出许多倍呢？”
面对这样的疑问，李衍道微笑着解释道：“这是因为我的云雨术有了显着进步，如今已经达到了大成的境界。”
对于李家这两位灵植师而言，云雨术从“大成”到“圆满”的差距，或许并不是那么好理解，故而他的解释，直接敷衍了过去。
李林燕和李衍云听到李衍道的回答后，脸上露出了难以置信的表情。
随即，他们纷纷向李衍道表达了祝贺之情：
“恭喜侄儿（二弟），你的云雨术再度精进，这样一来，家族每年便能额外增加数十枚灵石的收入了。”
李衍道闻言，爽朗地笑了起来：“哈哈，感谢三姑和大哥的祝贺。
将来你们若是修炼云雨术时遇到什么难题，尽管来找我，我会倾囊相授。”
“那我们就恭敬不如从命了，到时候可别嫌我们麻烦哦。”李林燕半开玩笑地说道。
李衍道摇头表示：“自然不会，能够帮助家族成员是我的荣幸。”
这时，远处走来的李松鹤打断了他们的谈话：
content_en:
"Grandpa, if the spiritual fish cannot bring enough spiritual stone income by then, we might as well consider removing the spiritual fish lake and use the spiritual caves there to open up more spiritual fields.
However, all this will have to wait until I am promoted to the later stage of Qi Refining. By then I should be able to take care of more than five acres of spiritual fields. "Li Yandao put forward his own idea.
Hearing his grandson's suggestion, Li Songhe was slightly startled, and then responded with a smile on his face: "Okay, everything will be up to my grandson's arrangement."
After the spiritual field is opened, if there is no support from the spiritual points provided by the spiritual veins, the spiritual power in the spiritual field will gradually dry up after a few years, eventually making it impossible to continue planting spiritual plants.
Although the spiritual field is not opened above the spiritual cave, you can still earn some spiritual stones, but the income will be greatly reduced. On average, one acre of spiritual field may only earn two or three spiritual stones a year.
However, if there is a spiritual cave, the situation is completely different.
The spiritual energy that continuously emerges from the spiritual cave can fully meet the consumption needs of the spiritual field.
Even if it is irrigated with entry-level cloud and rain techniques, one acre of spiritual land can bring in an income of about ten spiritual stones every year.
There are six spiritual caves on Fenglin Island, five of which are used to open up spiritual lakes and raise spiritual fish, while the other is specially used to open up spiritual fields.
Currently, the spiritual acupoints under the Li family's five acres of spiritual land can produce five rays of spiritual energy every day, which can stably support the consumption of the five acres of spiritual land.
Among the five spiritual fish lakes, one spiritual cave is particularly outstanding. It can produce ten rays of spiritual energy every day.
If this largest spiritual cave is used to open up a spiritual field, then it is enough to cultivate an acre of first-class spiritual fields.
Such spiritual fields can grow spiritual plants of extremely high quality.
As for the other four spiritual lakes, the number of spiritual energy produced by their spiritual caves every day is one, two, three and six strands respectively.
Among them, two strands of spiritual energy can be used to cultivate an acre of first-class middle-grade spiritual fields, while five strands of spiritual energy can support the growth of an acre of first-class high-grade spiritual fields.
It can be seen from this that the importance of the spiritual points in the spiritual veins to the spiritual field is self-evident.
After completing the opening of the spiritual field, Li Yandao had to wait patiently for a full month so that the new land could fully absorb the spiritual energy surrounding it.
On the appointed day for sowing, Li Yandao and his grandfather set foot on the two acres of newly opened spiritual fields and started sowing.
They carefully scattered the precious Shuiling rice seeds into the soil.
These spiritual seeds were expensive, and it took a total of four spiritual stones to purchase them.
Sowing spiritual fields is not the specialty of spiritual planters. In the Li family, whenever there is a new spiritual field that needs to be sown, the family members will always act together.
On this day, Li Linyan and Li Yanyun also came to assist.
However, when the sowing was completed, Li Linyan and Li Yanyun couldn't help but cast their eyes on the nearby spiritual field, where the Shuiling Rice was cared for by Li Yandao himself.
There was some confusion on their faces because what they saw surprised them.
Li Linyan finally couldn't restrain her curiosity and asked:
"Nephew Yandao, why is it that the Shui Ling rice you have planted in the past month has produced many times more spiritual rice on the ears than what we have planted?"
Faced with such questions, Li Yandao smiled and explained: "This is because my cloud and rain skills have made significant progress and have now reached the level of Dacheng."
For the two spiritual plant masters of the Li family, the gap between "Great Success" and "Perfection" of Yun Yu Technique may not be easy to understand, so his explanation was just perfunctory.
After hearing Li Yandao's answer, Li Linyan and Li Yanyun had expressions of disbelief on their faces.
Immediately, they expressed their congratulations to Li Yandao:
"Congratulations to my nephew (second brother), your cloud and rain skills have improved again. This way, the family can increase the income of dozens of spiritual stones every year."
Li Yandao heard this and laughed heartily: "Haha, thank you Third Aunt andCongratulations from brother.
If you encounter any difficulties in practicing Yun Yu Technique in the future, just come to me and I will teach you everything I can. "
“Then it’s better for us to be respectful than to obey orders. Don’t think it’s troublesome for us when the time comes. "Li Linyan said half-jokingly.
Li Yandao shook his head and said: "Of course not, it is my honor to be able to help family members. "
At this time, Li Songhe came from a distance and interrupted their conversation:
